sections.Profile:
The Sheriff and Lawman pinball machines, both released by Gottlieb in 1971, are essentially the same game with slight differences in player capacity and artwork. Sheriff is a four-player version, while Lawman is a two-player variant. Both machines feature a Wild West law enforcement theme, designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1971–1979
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Western, Card games, Original Theme, 1970s, Guns, Police
